review.notes: Full review at an unchanged head. Previous R01 and R02 are not repaired: the board's design/plan.json still declares the gaps sphere-bundle-embedding (provided by the pins: ContMDiff.iff_comp_isImmersion with isSmoothEmbedding_coe_sphereBundle) and connection-map-jacobi-derivative (owned by README section 9.3), although three replies report them removed; both are re-raised (P2) and need a change to the board's plan, not to the roadmap folder. New: one P3 Check in section 6.5 (the instance delta = 0.6 on a period-1 orbit does not violate (F2), since e <= 0.4 excludes the pair; delta = 1 does). Sample: all 15 seeded targets; 51 line ranges read in 11 cached sources; the uncertified texts (KatokHasselblatt1995, Bowen1975 and others) not read, so section 9.3's source is unverified. Gate: every check 0; depcheck 256 roadmaps, 2432 edges, 0 problems; lake env lean: 15 sorry warnings only; #check of all 50 declarations; one-tactic probe closes none of the 15 theorems. Restated supplier definitions compared with ClassicalErgodicTheory's Lean at its open head: they agree. Adversarial table of 27 rows found no false theorem in README or Suggested.lean. One source error recorded (BowenRuelle1975, proof of Theorem 5.1: radius 2 epsilon should be 3 epsilon).
